name: backup-guard
description: Plugin WordPress de sauvegarde, restauration et migration, sans licence ni verrou.

scripts.env:start: npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 start && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp plugin activate backup-guard
scripts.services:up: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d && node tools/init-services.js
scripts.test:destinations: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/tests/integration/destinations.php
scripts.test:notifications: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/tests/integration/notifications.php
scripts.test:backups: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/tests/integration/backups.php
scripts.i18n:build: npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/backup-guard wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/languages/backup-guard.pot --slug=backup-guard --domain=backup-guard --exclude=vendor,tests,tools,dist,node_modules,languages && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/languages
scripts.test:i18n: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/tests/integration/i18n.php
scripts.test:errors: node tools/connect-network.js && npx --yes @wordpress/env@12 run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/backup-guard/tests/integration/errors.php
